Completing a bot-detection challenge is not done by this project, so nothing was downloaded. The owner can place the XLSX by hand in data/external/aihw/ and re-run `make calibrate-fit`.

note: External datasets are untrusted input: kept only under data/external/ (gitignored), read only by tools/calibration scripts run with python3 -I.
